newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady in moderate weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady in moderate weather.

text.p: Wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held mostly steady Monday with moderate weather and limited demand through much of the state, brokers and marketers said.
Prices for peak, firm power for Tuesday delivery were talked at $26.00-27.00, steady to lower from a range of $26.00-28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) late last week, the sources said.
Off-peak ERCOT power was seen steady at $13.00-15.00.
December peak power was talked steady at $24.25-24.75, while January/February ERCOT power prices held in the $24.50-25.50 range, the sources said.
Texas Utilities' 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak unit 1 in Glen Rose, Texas was expected to restart later this week from scheduled refueling and maintenance, the company said.
